name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.exists_scaledCupBounds_few_low_jumps
summary: V = ⋂_j preimage of deepConstants(S, j, 0, c_j); its colength is bounded by the sum of exists_relLength_deepConstants_le; for d ∈ V the walk (scaledCupBounds_of_points_at_cuts, every letter a cut) applies with the deep points of S over d and points of T and the third side from the cokernel killers.

steps.claim: Take V = ⋂_j constantAt(S, j)⁻¹(deepConstants(S, j, 0, c_j)):
steps.lean:
refine ⟨_, (relLength_iInf_le ..).trans ((sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ (relLength_comap ..).trans_le
    (map_top (S.constantAt i) ▸ exists_relLength_deepConstants_le hk hp ha hb hs hU hn hr
    i :)).trans (mod_cast by simp [← mul_sum, ← sum_mul, Equiv.sum_comp]; lia)), fun _ P c V d
    h ↦ P.scaledCupBounds_of_points_at_cuts (e' := 0) ⊤ (ε · = 1) 1 (by simp; tauto) (fun i _ ↦
    ((mem_iInf _).1 h i).rec fun x ⟨⟨s, _, t⟩, e⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨_, 0, pointsOver_nonempty_of_noMultipleNear
    (pointsOver_nonempty_of_killsCokernel (killsCokernel_of_isUnramified 0 a ?_ hk hp) c) (hs i)
    (raisedAtE (2 * a + η)) ?_, ⟨⟩, ?x⟩, ⟨_, 1, ⟨_, x.2, by simpa, mem_withExponents_of_deep
    s t, t⟩, ⟨⟩, ?y⟩, pointsOver_nonempty_of_noMultipleNear (pointsOver_nonempty_of_killsCokernel
    (killsCokernel_of_isUnramified 0 a ?_ hk hp) 1) (hs i) (raisedAtE a) ?_, ?_⟩) (by simp [hk.2])⟩

steps.claim: its relative colength is at most Σ_j of the bounds of exists_relLength_deepConstants_le (relLength_iInf_le, relLength_comap), which sum to ≤ 11·Σ_j(n(j)(a + 1) + r(j)(W + 1));
steps.lean:
(relLength_iInf_le ..).trans ((sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ (relLength_comap ..).trans_le
    (map_top (S.constantAt i) ▸ exists_relLength_deepConstants_le hk hp ha hb hs hU hn hr
    i :)).trans (mod_cast by simp [← mul_sum, ← sum_mul, Equiv.sum_comp]; lia)),

steps.claim: for d ∈ V and T, P, c apply scaledCupBounds_of_points_at_cuts with every letter a cut and Q(j) = (ε(j) = 1): at each j, T has the point from killsCokernel_of_isUnramified deepened to raisedAtE(2a + η), S has the deep point over d (from V), and the third side the point over 1 from killsCokernel_of_isUnramified deepened to raisedAtE(a).
steps.lean:
fun _ P c V d
    h ↦ P.scaledCupBounds_of_points_at_cuts (e' := 0) ⊤ (ε · = 1) 1 (by simp; tauto) (fun i _ ↦
    ((mem_iInf _).1 h i).rec fun x ⟨⟨s, _, t⟩, e⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨_, 0, pointsOver_nonempty_of_noMultipleNear
    (pointsOver_nonempty_of_killsCokernel (killsCokernel_of_isUnramified 0 a ?_ hk hp) c) (hs i)
    (raisedAtE (2 * a + η)) ?_, ⟨⟩, ?x⟩, ⟨_, 1, ⟨_, x.2, by simpa, mem_withExponents_of_deep
    s t, t⟩, ⟨⟩, ?y⟩, pointsOver_nonempty_of_noMultipleNear (pointsOver_nonempty_of_killsCokernel
    (killsCokernel_of_isUnramified 0 a ?_ hk hp) 1) (hs i) (raisedAtE a) ?_, ?_⟩) (by simp [hk.2])⟩

steps.claim: The HasDeepPoint inequalities of S and T: by cases on the levels and the signs, from V's depths and the windows hU, hb.
steps.lean:
case x | y => rintro (_ | _ | _) u _ v _ <;> obtain ⟨w, x, _, _, e | e⟩ := V _ _ ‹_›, hU _ _
                  ‹_›, hb (k.letterFrob.symm i), hb i, units_eq_one_or (ε i) <;> simp [e, raisedAtE,
    stdExponent, abs_le, ite_apply] at w x ⊢ <;> omega
